title: Perceptual recipes — PERCEPTUAL-FORMS-001G
what_this_is: Seven bounded studies, as DATA. A recipe is an ordered list of direct acts somebody could
have performed one at a time, written down so they can be performed the same way twice.
It is not a plan, not a policy and not a program: nothing here branches, nothing here
loops, and nothing here reads a result in order to decide what to do next.
EVERY OPERATION STEP EXPANDS TO A `DirectCommand` AND GOES THROUGH THE SAME RESOLVER a
pressed control does. There is no second execution path, so 'a recipe reaches the same
producer as direct invocation' is not a property that has to be maintained — it is the
only arrangement the expander can produce.
NO MODEL CHOOSES OR REWRITES ANY OF THIS. A recipe is selected by a person; its steps are
fixed; a language model that wanted to change one would have to edit this file.

step_kinds.operation: a declared direct operation. Becomes a DirectCommand and counts against `max_operations`. EVERY operation reaches an adapter, including `extent.draw` — the person's hand goes through the same machinery — so only the non-manual ones count against `max_model_calls`, which is the budget that is actually scarce
step_kinds.derivation: a pure producer in this repository. Reads recorded artifacts, calls nothing, and counts against nothing
step_kinds.asks_for: declared parameters a PERSON supplies at run time. A concept is somebody's word and a drawn mask is their hand; a recipe fixes the shape of the act and never the content of those. A binding for anything not listed here is refused

recipes.label: Boundary and void study
recipes.question: Where exactly does its edge run, and what does it enclose?

steps.why: the masks are the substrate; everything after this reads them and adds nothing
the edge as closed curves, traced along the cracks between pixels
the bounded voids of each piece, each carrying the inner ring that bounds it

stop_conditions.reason: something looked over the whole image and found nothing separable. There is no boundary to trace and no void to find, and that is an answer
the masks were traced and enclosed nothing. An empty mask has no boundary; this is not a mask that was never traced
nothing looked. Unavailable is not empty, and reporting an empty extent set here would be the single worst thing this laboratory could do

decision_points.asks: Is that dark shape a void INSIDE this extent, or the gap between this one and the next?
decision_points.why_a_person: the producer answers it by whether the void reaches the frame, which is exact and is not the same question. A void that runs off the edge of the picture is undecidable from this crop and is reported as examined-and-not-a-hole

recipes.label: Fragment continuity study
recipes.question: These separate pieces — are any of them one thing?
prerequisites: a concept to search for has been named by a person

steps.why: the named search; the concept is the person's word and the mask is the measurement
the connected pieces, with no claim about whether they belong together. Safe to compute eagerly because nothing downstream can read unity out of it
a person's proposed grouping, assembled with its grounds and its cost. Nothing here computes the grouping

stop_conditions.reason: the fragments were considered and no grouping was supportable. This is not a fragment set and it is not a hard mask of the union

stop_conditions.when: a proposed grouping's only ground is an admitted-as-one-ground-among-several model
stop_conditions.reason: resemblance is not unity. `false-similarity` is the committed proof: three identical discs, and any appearance threshold gives one confident group of three

stop_conditions.when: the fused hypothesis form is deferred in this deployment
stop_conditions.reason: the payload is assembled and is not writable. The shape is settled a phase before anything writes it

decision_points.asks: Are these pieces one thing, and does saying so require asserting extent nobody saw?
decision_points.why_a_person: the second half changes the claim, not a flag on it. Grouping what is visible is `interpretive`; asserting what continues behind the fence is `uncertain`, and no confidence moves it
options: one thing, all of it visible
one thing, and it continues behind something

recipes.label: Visible versus inferred study
recipes.question: Which of this did we see, which did we infer, and which do we not know?
prerequisites: an extent that is partly hidden has been selected
no model is admitted to produce this form; the inferred part comes from a person or a fixture

steps.why: the part that is visible, measured. This is the only step in the study that looks at the image
a person paints what they believe continues behind the occluder. Their hand, not a guess from words
the three parts assembled, with three statuses. An overlap between any two refuses the whole partition

stop_conditions.when: nothing falls outside the visible part
stop_conditions.reason: the extent was partitioned and all of it was seen. This is not a hard mask of visible plus inferred
a pixel in two parts is one the record cannot place, and a reader drawing the tricolour would paint a hallucinated leg in the same colour as a photographed one

stop_conditions.when: a person declines to paint an inferred part
stop_conditions.reason: the visible part stands on its own. An absent inferred part is not an empty one

decision_points.asks: Where does the inferred part stop and the unknown part begin?
decision_points.why_a_person: not-seen-and-not-inferred is a real third part. The pixels that run off the frame are settled by nothing, and forcing them into either of the other two is the trap `partition` was built to catch
options: inferred: I can say where it continues

recipes.label: Courtyard hierarchy study
recipes.question: Palace, courtyard, garden, fountain — what is inside what, and what is part of what?
prerequisites: a chain crossing the organ boundary has been confirmed by a person

steps.why: the levels, as extents. Every level is a real extent with a real identity
the nestings, measured per pixel by the Topology facade
the relations assembled into a nesting, with transitivity absorbed and disagreements reported
the levels with their fractions, and with geometric containment kept distinct from asserted part/whole

stop_conditions.reason: the extents were compared for nesting and none contained another. This is a flat extent set, not a failure

stop_conditions.when: the relations disagree in a loop
stop_conditions.reason: a containment cycle means the inputs disagree. Dropping an edge to make a tree would hide the disagreement behind a clean picture

stop_conditions.when: an instance carries no geometry revision
stop_conditions.reason: a tree that cannot be told it has gone stale is worse than none, so the unpinned level is left out and named

decision_points.asks: Is the fountain INSIDE the courtyard, or PART OF it?
decision_points.why_a_person: a pigeon standing in a courtyard is contained by it and is not part of it; the wall around the court is part of it and is not inside it. Geometry answers the first and only a person answers the second

recipes.label: Piazza negative-space study
recipes.question: Where is the crowd, and where is the space it leaves?
prerequisites: a chain crossing the organ boundary has been confirmed by a person

steps.why: the members of the collection, each measured. There is no object called `crowd`
the separable pieces, so the count is of things rather than of proposals
one sample per counted member, with the kernel declared. The count is exact; the field is a choice
the space the collection leaves, measured by the Topology facade rather than inferred from the density

stop_conditions.reason: the members were counted and the field is everywhere zero. This is not a soft field and not a hard mask of the convex hull

stop_conditions.when: a member carries neither a mask nor a box
stop_conditions.reason: there is nowhere to place its sample. Counting it and not placing it would make the field disagree with its own count
the unsmoothed histogram is produced and stays `calibrated`. Smoothing is a decision and is never taken on a person's behalf

decision_points.asks: What bandwidth, and are you prepared to lose the unit?
decision_points.why_a_person: the bandwidth is the single biggest determinant of what the field looks like, and smoothing turns members-per-cell into weighted neighbours. The count survives it; the calibration does not

recipes.label: Topology sensitivity study
recipes.question: How little has to change before the relation does?
prerequisites: two revisions of one extent are recorded
both endpoints carry a geometry revision

steps.why: the relations at the first revision
the relations at the second, measured the same way so the difference is in the geometry
what changed between two pinned revisions, and what merely moved without changing

stop_conditions.when: the two revisions are the same revision
stop_conditions.reason: the pair was re-measured, not revised. A transition between a thing and itself is not a finding

stop_conditions.when: an endpoint carries no geometry revision
stop_conditions.reason: a change nobody can see the start of is not a finding, it is a rumour
the pair was compared across two revisions and the relation held. That is the answer the study was asking for

decision_points.asks: Did the RELATION change, or did the object?
decision_points.why_a_person: one pixel closing a gap turns `disjoint` into `meets`, and a producer with any tolerance at all misses it. Whether that one pixel is a finding or a segmentation wobble is not a question geometry can answer

recipes.label: Ambiguous form hypothesis study
recipes.question: The picture supports more than one reading. What are they?
prerequisites: at least two competing readings have been drawn or named by a person

steps.why: the first reading, as a named search. The word is the person's; the mask is the measurement
the second reading, measured the same way so the two are comparable
the readings held open, ordered by derived id so nothing in the record reads as a winner

stop_conditions.reason: one alternative is not an alternative set. A single surviving reading is a hard mask, and recording it here would dress one answer as a preserved ambiguity
a weight attached to nothing is a number about nothing
resolution is a separate act that produces a separate artifact. This record has no field a choice could be written into, and the alternatives survive it

decision_points.asks: Are these genuinely competing readings, or is one of them simply wrong?
decision_points.why_a_person: the form preserves an ambiguity and cannot create one. Two readings of a shadow are an ambiguity; a reading and a mistake are not, and only somebody looking can say which pair this is
options: there is a third reading nobody has drawn
